title: botai spaced repetition deck
description: An SM-2 review deck for one learner: when each learning objective is due next, and how it is going. The deck schedules reviews; it never decides mastery — that still requires evidence in the progress record. Cards are per-objective, so a due review points at a specific thing to revisit rather than at a course in general.

student_id.description: UUID, the same identity key as `learner_id` in the progress and session records and `student_id` in the learning profile — one deck per learner, keyed the same way everywhere.

cards.description: One card per learning objective being reviewed. Empty is valid: a learner with nothing yet scheduled has an empty deck, not a broken one.

interval_days.description: Current SM-2 interval in whole days. Floor of 1: a sub-day interval is not a spaced review.

ease_factor.description: SM-2 ease factor. The floor is 1.3 — SM-2 clamps it there so repeated failures stop shrinking the interval toward zero; a lower value is an algorithm bug, not a struggling learner.

lapses.description: Times a review was failed after having been learned. Distinct from review_count: lapses drive relearning, attempts drive interval growth.

review_card.description: One review card, keyed by objective. All fields are scheduling state — none of them is a mastery claim.
